safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with lip swelling for the past 1 hour.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts note lip swelling after prawn soup but do not state the duration as 'past 1 hour' (no explicit ~1 hour timeframe).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the approximate duration (~1 hour) reduces the ability to trend progression and time-course relative to exposure, which is relevant in suspected anaphylaxis but does not usually change immediate emergency management when active airway/breathing symptoms are present.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a sensation of throat closing.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts document dyspnoea/chest tightness but do not include a throat-closing sensation.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document a throat-closing sensation omits a key red-flag symptom of impending airway compromise in anaphylaxis/angioedema, which can affect triage urgency and downstream escalation decisions.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No dizziness is mentioned in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Dizziness can signal hypotension in anaphylaxis; omission could lead to under-recognition of severity and less aggressive monitoring, though it may not alter the already-appropriate decision to call emergency services based on dyspnea.
